indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX buyer_preferences_pkey ON public.buyer_preferences USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX buyer_preferences_buyer_id_key ON public.buyer_preferences USING btree (buyer_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX buyers_pkey ON public.buyers USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX idx_buyers_tier ON public.buyers USING btree (tier)
CREATE INDEX idx_buyers_land_type ON public.buyers USING btree (land_buyer_type) WHERE (land_buyer_type IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_buyers_buys_land ON public.buyers USING btree (buys_land) WHERE (buys_land = true)
CREATE INDEX idx_buyers_import_log_id ON public.buyers USING btree (import_log_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX deals_pkey ON public.deals USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX idx_deals_stage ON public.deals USING btree (stage)
CREATE INDEX idx_deals_closing_date ON public.deals USING btree (closing_date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX deals_one_active_lead ON public.deals USING btree (lead_id) WHERE (stage <> ALL (ARRAY['closed'::text, 'cancelled'::text]))

triggers.name: buyers_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER buyers_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.buyers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at()

triggers.name: deals_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER deals_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.deals FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at()

triggers.name: update_buyer_preferences_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER update_buyer_preferences_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.buyer_preferences FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()

constraints.name: buyers_import_log_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (import_log_id) REFERENCES buyer_import_log(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: buyer_preferences_buyer_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (buyer_id) REFERENCES buyers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
